numerical_checks: Analytic comparisons use 28 to 55 mixed decimal digits, with fresh 55/80 digit boundary data and order 40/64 in the independent Puiseux refinement test. No f64 conversion of arbitrary-precision values.

prior_failures.cause: Existing Frobenius numerical recurrence passed native complex coefficients directly to a rational Q-polynomial conversion. Fixed by the existing exact imaginary-parameter encoding before native polynomial conversion. A dependent-root test also overconstrained the existing error variant: a zero norm may be InvalidInput as well as Unsupported.

The endpoint evaluator initially checked source domains only when lifting its matching boundary. A newly added regression showed it accepted a canceled source hole at a later local evaluation. The matched expansion now retains the compiled original domain guards and exact singularity polynomials, checking exact point substitution before evaluation. The final source-hash-verified run passes that same regression.

independent_review.resolved_finding: Rename physical_limit to coefficient_limits and add epsilon/x regression; flattened epsilon coefficients cannot reconstruct symbolic dimensional-sector provenance.

ownership_audit.exact_root_algebra: Existing Symbolica AlgebraicQuotient normalization; no replacement quotient implementation.
ownership_audit.series_and_linear_algebra: Existing prepared rational Frobenius engine, Symbolica exact algebra and arbitrary-precision Complex<Float>.
ownership_audit.graph_and_tensor_operations: None added; no replacement of HEPKit/Linnet/Spenso/Idenso functionality.

reference.implementation_provenance: Independently derived product-rule restriction of scalars; no GPL reference implementation was copied or translated.

limits: Coefficientwise finite limits after epsilon expansion; no inferred symbolic dimensional-regulator sectors.
Caller supplies local logarithm winding, matching sheet, and a point inside the convergence domain; no physical homotopy inference.
Working-precision values are not achieved-accuracy estimates or valid cache evidence without independent checks and propagated input uncertainty.
Dense dimension bounded by caller before allocation; generated monomial subgroup can still grow exponentially. Fewer than usize::BITS registered roots.
Inherited Fuchsian normalization and exact indicial-root support; irregular exponential sectors may be rejected.
No automatic singular-point insertion into the physical boundary cache or large-system performance-parity claim.
